Food_and_Beverage.name: Tampines Round Market & Food Centre (Hawker Centre)
Food_and_Beverage.description: Bustling hawker centre with over 40 stalls. Affordable local favourites such as chicken rice, laksa, char kway teow, and economy rice. Best for budget-friendly meals and authentic Singaporean food. Typical price range: S$4 - S$7.

Food_and_Beverage.name: Tenderfresh Classic
Food_and_Beverage.description: Halal-certified Western food chain famous for crispy fried chicken, chicken chop, and fish & chips. Family-friendly with quick service. Typical price range: S$8 - S$14.

Food_and_Beverage.name: Kopitiam Food Court
Food_and_Beverage.description: Air-conditioned food court with a wide variety of stalls: Korean, Japanese, Thai, Indian, Muslim cuisine, and Chinese zi char. Good for groups with different food preferences. Typical price range: S$5 - S$10.

Food_and_Beverage.name: Toast Box
Food_and_Beverage.description: Local cafe serving traditional kaya toast, soft-boiled eggs, kopi, and laksa. Quiet spot for breakfast, light meals, or a coffee break between errands. Typical price range: S$3 - S$8.

Food_and_Beverage.name: Subway
Food_and_Beverage.description: Build-your-own sandwich and salad chain. Healthier grab-and-go option, suitable for vegetarians and those watching their diet. Typical price range: S$6 - S$10.

General_Service_Counters.name: ServiceSG Centre
General_Service_Counters.description: One-stop counter for over 200 government services across multiple agencies. Walk-in or by appointment. Use this counter for broad government enquiries that don't fit one of the specific schemes at OTH.
handles: CPF enquiries, statements, and withdrawal questions
MOM Work Pass and employment enquiries
SingPass / Corppass assistance and password reset
General HDB enquiries (specific HDB schemes have their own counter)
Application and collection of government letters
Help for seniors and digitally less-confident residents

Fallback.name: OTH Information Counter
Fallback.location: Level 1, Main Atrium (near the main entrance)
Fallback.description: General enquiries counter for anything not covered by the listed services. Friendly staff can direct visitors to the right agency or facility within OTH.
